title.en: Netflix Acquires ‘An Open Field’ And ‘One Last Order’, Short Docs Primed For Oscar Contention
title.fa: نتفلیکس «یک میدان باز» و «آخرین سفارش» را می‌گیرد، اسناد کوتاهی که برای رقابت اسکار آماده شده‌اند.

excerpt.en: EXCLUSIVE: Netflix has acquired two award-winning documentary shorts that should put the streamer squarely back into Oscar contention. Set to join the platform are an open field, winner of Best Short Documentary at the 2025 International Documentary Festival (IDFA), and One Last Order, which has earned multiple honors including Best Documentary and the Audience Award […]
